items.title: US Treasury's Bessent, China's He to meet on Sunday at JPMorgan headquarters
items.summary: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng are scheduled to meet on Sunday at JPMorgan Chase headquarters in New York. The meeting will address AI security, trade, and other economic matters, occurring just days before President Donald Trump hosts Chinese President Xi Jinping at the White House. JPMorgan is providing its headquarters as a venue due to heightened security in Manhattan for the United Nations General Assembly.

items.title: What Is Driving the Conversation Around Barrick Mining (TSX:ABX)?
items.summary: This article discusses the factors influencing Barrick Mining (TSX:ABX) in the Canadian market, focusing on how precious-metals businesses are affected by changing bond yields, currency fluctuations, and geopolitical demand for defensive assets. Barrick's operations are centered on gold and copper mining, and its performance is tied to specific operating considerations rather than just the broader TSX trends. The article emphasizes that company-specific disclosures and activities are crucial for understanding its progression within the current market environment.

items.title: Freeport McMoRan (FCX) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher After Split Analyst Revisions
items.summary: Freeport-McMoRan (FCX) has seen its stock's fair value increase from US$70.68 to US$72.59 following recent analyst revisions. Analysts are divided, with some bullish on copper demand and Grasberg execution, setting price targets between US$70 and US$82, while others are cautious due to tariff risks and nickel market uncertainty. The fair value adjustment reflects changes in modeled revenue growth, net profit margin assumptions, future P/E multiple, and discount rate.

items.title: With Boats Getting Bigger, Money Is Flowing Into Marinas
items.summary: As the super-rich acquire larger and more expensive boats, the demand for suitable docking and repair facilities has surged, leading to significant investment in the marina business. Blackstone, a private equity firm, has capitalized on this trend, expanding its marina portfolio from zero in 2024 to approximately 200 globally, including a $5.6 billion acquisition of Safe Harbor in early 2025. This consolidation reflects a growing recognition of marinas as valuable waterfront infrastructure and entertainment destinations.

items.title: Can Costco Wholesale (NASDAQ:COST) Keep Its Value Edge?
items.summary: This article examines Costco Wholesale's position in the retail sector, focusing on its membership model and consumer value proposition. It emphasizes that while broader market trends provide context, Costco's success hinges on its operational execution, demand visibility, and strategic adaptability amidst changing market conditions, rather than short-term sentiment. The analysis highlights the importance of repeat customers, execution discipline, strategic fit, transparent communication, and cash pacing for the company's sustained value edge.
